prompt: Which instruction should Tao send Rin before tomorrow’s packing list closes?
promptZh: 明天的備貨清單截止前，陶應把哪項指示送給琳？

options.text: Leave both cases in Delivery and add a note asking the driver to keep the decaf at the shop for Sam.
options.zh: 兩箱都留在「配送」欄，在附註請司機把低咖啡因咖啡留在門市給山姆。
options.whyZh: 山姆自取的方向合適；但配送附註不是倉庫備貨時看的，兩箱會一起裝車，例行車來時店內只放得下一箱。

options.text: Put the house blend on the morning van and reserve the decaf for an afternoon delivery by the same van.
options.zh: 上午例行貨車送招牌配方；低咖啡因咖啡預留，下午再請同一台貨車送。
options.whyZh: 上午的配方與下午備貨都有著落，也等到有空間再收；但下午超出例行配送時間，同一台車也會加收。

options.text: Put the house blend in Delivery and the decaf in Shop Pickup. If needed, Sam will collect the decaf on his way back.
options.zh: 招牌配方列入「配送」，低咖啡因咖啡列入「門市自取」。有需要時山姆回來途中會自取。
options.whyZh: 招牌配方能上午送到，又不會讓車同時送兩箱。自取欄讓門市提早把低咖啡因咖啡留下；等儲藏室有空間，山姆可以經過時自取，不必要求逾時配送。

options.text: Put the house blend in Delivery and leave the decaf off the list. Sam can buy what remains at the shop without a delivery charge.
options.zh: 招牌配方列入「配送」，低咖啡因咖啡先不列入清單。山姆可以到門市買現貨，無須付配送費。
options.whyZh: 這樣保住上午的一箱，也免去配送費；但沒先請門市留貨，最後一箱可能賣掉，下午就沒有可用的備貨。

explanationZh: 招牌配方能上午送到，又不會讓車同時送兩箱。自取欄讓門市提早把低咖啡因咖啡留下；等儲藏室有空間，山姆可以經過時自取，不必要求逾時配送。
evidence: There’s also one if we ask the roastery to bring a case outside our usual delivery window / Our regular delivery window ends at noon. / cases left in the Delivery column are loaded together. / A delivery note is read at the café, not while the warehouse packs. / the roastery sets it aside for us at the shop instead. / until Sam clears it at 12:30. / He walks past the roastery on his way back from lunch. / but we’ll only have room for one when it arrives. / I need the house blend for morning service and want to avoid another special charge. / The shop can sell its last decaf case to another customer unless our case is already set aside.

vocabulary.note: 用於店家把商品另外留下供客人自取；與把貨物列入配送清單不同。
